set.prevailing_wage_basis: Density bonus under Gov. Code 65915 grants units, concessions and waivers of development standards, not public funds; Labor Code 1720(a)(1) (https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720) covers only construction paid for in whole or in part out of public funds, so the bonus itself does not trigger prevailing wage. Wages may still apply through other public financing or through streamlining laws that require them (for example SB 423 or AB 2011, Gov. Code 65912.130). The 2024 Housing Overlay ordinance (https://www.cityofmillvalley.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7829) waives lot merger fees for Opportunity Site projects; that waiver is public funds under Labor Code 1720(b)(4) but is de minimis under 1720(c)(3) (under $600,000 and under 2 percent of project cost) on any realistic project.

reason: Density bonus and overlays provide no public funds and the lot merger fee waiver is de minimis.

The site is City-owned land on a 99-year ground lease with City Trust Fund loans, which is also public funds under Labor Code 1720(b)(1) and (b)(3) (https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720).
